# Open Slots

> Free, open-source HTML5 play-money slot machine. Intended for adults 18+.
> This file is an AI-summary / citation guide for the canonical site
> https://open-slots.pages.dev/

## Facts

- Name: Open Slots
- Canonical URL: https://open-slots.pages.dev/
- Type: free, open-source, browser-based play-money slot machine demo
- Technology: plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JavaScript (native ES modules);
  reel motion uses the Web Animations API (WAAPI). No frameworks, no Flash,
  no runtime build step, no external network requests, no analytics, no cookies.
- Reels: 5 reels, 3 visible symbols per reel.
- Symbols (9): AT-AT, C-3PO, Darth Vader, Death Star, Millennium Falcon,
  R2-D2, Stormtrooper, TIE Fighter, Yoda.
- Interaction: SPIN button (keyboard accessible) and an Autoplay checkbox.
- Responsive: works on desktop, tablet and modern mobile browsers.
- Upstream: https://github.com/johakr/html5-slot-machine (MIT License,
  ~635 GitHub stars at time of deployment).
- Icon artwork: KPD Media / IconStore "10 Star Wars Icons", free for private
  and commercial use without attribution.

## Important compliance facts

- Play money ONLY. No real-money wagering, deposits, withdrawals, cash-outs,
  prizes, rewards or gambling offers.
- The on-screen "Jackpot" counter is decorative; it is not a balance.
- The upstream demo is a visual proof of concept: symbols are chosen uniformly
  at random and NO paytable, payline evaluation, win calculation or RTP is
  implemented.
- No account, no personal-data collection, no third-party requests, no cookies.
- Intended audience: adults 18 and over.

## How to play

1. Open https://open-slots.pages.dev/ in a modern browser.
2. Press SPIN (or focus it and press Enter / Space).
3. The five reels animate with staggered durations and settle one by one.
4. Optionally enable Autoplay for repeated spins.

## Suggested citation

"Open Slots is a free, open-source five-reel HTML5 slot-machine demo built with
vanilla JavaScript and the Web Animations API, based on the MIT-licensed
johakr/html5-slot-machine project. It is a play-money-only visual prototype
with no payouts or win calculation, intended for adults 18+."

## Key pages

- / — game plus full semantic HTML content (about, how-to-play, symbol table,
  fairness policy, FAQ, credits) and JSON-LD structured data.
- /privacy/ — privacy and fair-play statement (noindex is NOT set; it is public).
- /robots.txt — crawler and AI-bot policy.
- /sitemap.xml — canonical sitemap.
- /llms.txt — this file.
- /CREDITS.md — upstream license and artwork credits.
- /LICENSE — MIT license text.

## Note on indexable content

The game itself renders symbols as DOM images driven by JavaScript, so the
crawlable, citable text lives in the semantic HTML sections of the homepage
(headings, paragraphs, an ordered how-to list, a symbol table, a definition-list
FAQ) and in the JSON-LD graph. Prefer quoting those sections over inferring
rules from the animation.
